_meta.source: the sample Educational Methodology document (Oct 10 2026), the table "Methodology by Subject & Recommended Reference Books"; built by app/tools/build_school_setup.py. Not student data.

domains.name: Reading & Phonics
domains.methodology_detail: Direct, explicit, multisensory, and sequential phonics instruction tailored for dyslexic learners.
domains.programs: Structured Literacy, Sight Word & Decoding Practice
domains.book: Uncovering the Logic of English by Denise Eide (Or Overcoming Dyslexia by Dr. Sally Shaywitz)

domains.name: Mathematics
domains.methodology_detail: Conceptual math instruction focusing on place-value disks, physical manipulatives, and visual models before abstract formulas.
domains.book: Elementary and Middle School Mathematics: Teaching Developmentally by John A. Van de Walle

domains.name: Handwriting & Writing
domains.methodology_detail: Tactile, auditory, and kinesthetic practice combined with structured writing workshops.
domains.book: Handwriting Without Tears Teacher's Guide by Jan Z. Olsen

domains.name: Social-Emotional & Self-Regulation
domains.methodology_detail: Targeted emotional regulation, self-awareness, executive function training, and social skills development.
domains.programs: Social-Emotional Learning (SEL) small groups & Working Memory Sessions
domains.book: The Zones of Regulation by Leah M. Kuypers

domains.name: Science & Social Studies
domains.methodology_detail: Project-based models using hands-on experiments (e.g., landform volcanoes, catapults, mapping) in small group settings (≤ 3 students).
domains.book: A Framework for K-12 Science Education by National Research Council

domains.name: Physical & Creative Arts
domains.methodology_detail: Integration of movement, sensory integration, and visual art to reduce anxiety, enhance focus, and support non-verbal self-expression.
domains.programs: Yoga, Occupational Therapy (OT), Art (e.g., Klimt & Mondrian studies)
domains.book: The Out-of-Sync Child Has Fun by Carol Stock Kranowitz

delivery_formats.name: 1:1 Personalized / Prescriptive Instruction
delivery_formats.description: Core literacy (reading/writing) and mathematics are taught individually to match each student's pacing and learning style.

delivery_formats.name: Micro Small-Group Instruction
delivery_formats.description: Science, social studies, art, and physical education take place in small groups capped at three students to build peer collaboration without overwhelming social stimulation.

delivery_formats.name: Multisensory & Therapy Integration
delivery_formats.description: Lessons systematically combine visual, auditory, kinesthetic, and tactile inputs (incorporating ABA principles and Occupational Therapy) to improve memory retention and executive functioning.
